credit_line: Gift of The Georgia O'Keeffe Foundation
description: An evening portrait of a man, dressed in a denim shirt and jeans, preparing food at an outside table covered with jars of can goods, condiments and cooking supplies.   This photograph is part of an album created by Ansel Adams after his 1938 trip to Yosemite with Georgia O'Keeffe, David McAlpin, and Helen and Godfrey Rockefeller. This is one of only three albums created for his travel companions documenting their trip.
title: Al Rhode
